title: Adam: Name Meaning, Origin & Personality
summary: Adam is a short, timeless name shared by many languages and cultures. It is linked to the earth and to humanity itself, which gives it a warm, grounded feeling.
origin: Adam comes from Hebrew, where it is usually connected with 'adamah', the earth or soil, and with the idea of a human being. The name is known in Jewish, Christian and Muslim traditions as the name of the first man, so it has travelled into almost every language with the same spelling. In Arabic it is written آدم. Today it is loved across Europe, North Africa and the Middle East because it is easy to say in many languages.
personality: People often picture an Adam as calm, reliable and kind, someone friends turn to for honest advice. The name's link to the earth suggests a practical, down-to-earth person who builds things step by step. Adams are often described as loyal, protective of their family and quietly confident, with a simple style and a good sense of humour. Its short, strong sound also gives an impression of a natural leader who does not need to be loud to be heard.
popularity: Adam is one of the most popular boys' names in France, Belgium, Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia, and it is also common in the United Kingdom, Sweden, Poland and the Arab world. Its success comes from being international: families who speak different languages can all pronounce it the same way.

faq.q: What does the name Adam mean?
faq.ans: Adam is usually understood to mean 'man' or 'made from the earth', from the Hebrew word for soil. It expresses humanity and simplicity.
Adam has Hebrew roots, but it is fully part of Arabic culture as آدم and is a very common name for Muslim boys. It is used the same way in Arabic, French and English.
In English it sounds like 'A-dum', while in French and Arabic it is closer to 'A-dam' with a clear second syllable. Both are correct.

faq.q: What is a good middle name for Adam?
faq.ans: Short and long names both work well, for example Adam Elias, Adam Youssef or Adam Gabriel. Choose a middle name with a different number of syllables for a nice rhythm.
